recap: Cavaliers beat the Celtics 118–114 in overtime.
Donovan Mitchell led the Cavaliers with 40 points (14-34 FG, 4-11 3PT), 11 rebounds and 4 assists.
Jaylen Brown led the Celtics with 32 points (12-26 FG, 1-7 3PT), 13 rebounds and 9 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 51.0 to 49.5.
Biggest swing: Donovan Mitchell makes free throw 1 of 2 (Q4 5.1), +37 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): LeVert, Mitchell, Stevens, Garland, Mobley, +19 in 12:14.
Bench points: CLE 23, BOS 50. Points in the paint: 56–44. Second-chance points: 19–14.
